section.sectionSummaryBrief: The perfection of the sacrificial service will be specifically in the future, though currently it exists through study.
section.t: And behold, the perfection of the service of the sacrifices
("My fire-offering, My bread")
will be specifically in the future.
For even in the time of exile there is the matter of sacrifices through engaging in the study of the Torah of sacrifices,
as it is said,
"And we will render [the] bulls [of] our lips,"
which also includes the concept of "and we will render" from the term "completion,"
nevertheless, the main aspect of this will be in the future,
and in the language of the prayer,
"And there we will perform before You as the command of Your will,"
that specifically in the future will be the fulfillment of all the commandments,
and particularly the commandment of offering the sacrifices, which is the main service,
in the ultimate perfection.
And it can be said that it is explicit in the verses
that in the future there will also be fields
(and perhaps it can be said that Jerusalem relative to the Holy Temple is analogous to a field,
in addition to the fields literally outside Jerusalem).
Except that then the partitions that now exist between city and field will be nullified,
for the revelation in the Holy Temple
(city)
will spread also to Jerusalem the holy city and also to the fields and plots outside Jerusalem,
in the manner of our sages' statement,
"In the future, Jerusalem will expand
throughout all the Land of Israel, and in the future the Land of Israel will expand throughout all the lands,"
and as it is said,
"And the glory of Havayah will be revealed, and all flesh together will see, etc."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This explains the connection of the discourse on nullifying partitions to the portion of Shoftim, culminating in the expansion of borders and the revelation of Chabad.
section.t: And based on this, we can explain and interpret also the hint in the connection of the content of this discourse
(the matter of nullifying the partitions,
all equally)
with the portion of Shoftim,
which is revealed with the conclusion of the portion.
For behold, the matter of judges and officers etc.
is
(as above)
to clarify the distinction
(and the partitions)
between one another,
between one law and another, etc.,
but when the action of the judges is completed and continues afterwards in the conduct "to walk in His ways all the days,"
then the nullification of the partitions occurs, etc., until afterwards "Havayah your God will expand your border"
(by means of that beforehand you shall guard, etc., to walk in His ways all the days),
for the matter of "Havayah your God will expand your border" can be said, in spirituality, to be the concept of that which in the future the Land of Israel will expand throughout all the lands.
And until there will also be the revelation of the aspect of Chabad,
as our sages said
on the verse "Havayah your God will expand your border," which refers to the Kenite, Kenizzite, and Kadmonite,
and it is explained in the discourse "Do not distress Moab" of the Mitteler Rebbe
that they are the aspects of Chabad.
For the drawing down now is only the aspect of the seven lower Sefiros,
and it will expand in the future,
and it can be said that this is particularly through the preparatory service of "spreading your wellsprings outward" in a manner of understanding and comprehension
("they will be sustained from it"),
Chabad,
and moreover, even the three lands
(Chabad)
will be in a manner of conquest,
that one becomes "master of the house" also over them, and even this part of Torah is "his Torah" that is called by his name.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: May it be His will that through spreading the wellsprings and conquering Chabad in the soul, we will soon conquer Chabad in the world, ending the exile and achieving the perfection of the future.
section.t: And may it be His will that it be so for us,
that through the preparatory service of spreading the wellsprings outward and the conquest of Chabad within the soul,
we will come, very soon, to the conquest of Chabad in the world,
until the ultimate conquest, in a manner that it is called by his name.
And this will be fulfilled in a manner of "I will hasten it" and with alacrity,
that immediately and at once
(in the language of the Rambam)
the exile ends,
and we conquer in perfection the land of the seven nations,
and immediately afterwards also the land of the three nations,
and together the land of the ten nations,
for the number ten indicates the perfection of the future,
and as our sages said that the harp of the future has ten strings,
and in the future there will be the tenth song,
and the tenth heifer,
and the tenth count,
that the Holy One, blessed be He, counts Israel because of His great love for them.
And all this speedily in our days, literally,
in our time and place,
souls in bodies,
and with joy and a good heart.
